description: This file defines the CloudHSMV2Client class for interacting with the AWS CloudHSM V2 service. It includes method signatures for various CloudHSM operations such as creating, deleting, and describing clusters and backups, with support for asynchronous variants.

classes.name: CloudHSMV2Client
classes.description: Client class for interacting with AWS CloudHSM V2, providing methods to perform operations like creating, deleting, and describing clusters and backups.

methods.name: copyBackupToRegion
methods.description: Copies a backup to a specified AWS region.

methods.name: copyBackupToRegionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously copies a backup to a specified AWS region.

methods.name: createClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new CloudHSM cluster.

methods.name: createHsm
methods.description: Creates a new HSM within a cluster.

methods.name: createHsmAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new HSM within a cluster.

methods.name: deleteHsm
methods.description: Deletes an HSM from a cluster.

methods.name: deleteHsmAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an HSM from a cluster.

methods.name: getResourcePolicy
methods.description: Gets the resource policy attached to a resource.

methods.name: getResourcePolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets the resource policy attached to a resource.

methods.name: listTagsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: modifyBackupAttributesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously modifies attributes of a backup.

methods.name: putResourcePolicy
methods.description: Attaches a resource policy to a resource.

methods.name: putResourcePolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously attaches a resource policy to a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
